market_question: Will Liverpool finish in the top 4 of the EPL 2025–26 standings?
reasoning: Liverpool have finished top 4 in 7 of the last 8 seasons, are on course for the 2024‑25 title under Arne Slot, and will likely retain a deep, title‑contending squad. The 52.5% implied probability prices them as if a top‑4 miss is a coin flip, far below their demonstrated consistency.
evidence_points: Liverpool finished top 4 in all but one of the last 8 EPL campaigns (the exception being 2022‑23).
In 2024‑25 they are dominating the league, demonstrating Slot’s system and squad quality.
The club’s revenue and depth allow reinvestment, making a significant drop‑off unlikely barring a major crisis.
sources_consulted: 2024‑25 Premier League table as of April 2025
Liverpool’s performance under Arne Slot in 2024‑25
